content:
We just published our list, 10 Best Healthcare Stocks To Buy for 2027 , and Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated ranked 9th on this list.

The healthcare sector is emerging as an attractive investment opportunity heading into 2027, supported by rising demand for medical services, pharmaceutical innovation, and advances in biotechnology. Growing investment in treatments for chronic diseases, oncology, obesity, and other complex medical conditions is also creating opportunities.

Healthcare stocks have delivered solid gains in 2026. The S&P 500 Healthcare Sector is already up by 15% for the year, nearly triple the 5.52% gain for the broader market, underscoring renewed focus on healthcare stocks. Wall Street is also identifying opportunities among companies reaching record share prices, as highlighted in our report on the  10 Best All-Time High Stocks to Buy According to Wall Street .

Amid the gains Wall Street analysts are becoming increasingly bullish as the sector offers more attractive opportunities outside technology. The growing optimism is driven by improving earnings expectations, attractive valuations, and prospects that the sector will benefit from artificial intelligence (AI).

According to State Street Investment Management, earnings in the sector will continue improving. Its outlook identifies improving biopharmaceutical fundamentals, recovering demand for life sciences services, and stabilizing managed-care businesses as important catalysts.

AllianceBernstein, on its part, argues that healthcare's innovation pipeline remains strong and that investors may be overlooking the sector's growth potential because they are concentrated in AI-related stocks. A rotation away from tech amid an AI selloff also presents an opportunity for investors to explore healthcare stocks with attractive growth prospects and significant upside potential.

Analysts also see opportunities among established pharmaceutical companies—the investment thesis centers on strong cash flows, established drug portfolios, and dividend payments. The  best healthcare and insurance stocks  are also on the spot following the Democrats' midterm sweep. That's because they are expected to push for potential changes to Medicaid funding and Affordable Care Act subsidies.

However, healthcare stocks face different challenges. Regulatory uncertainty, drug pricing pressures, patent expirations, and competition from generic medicines pose significant risks. These factors make company fundamentals, revenue growth, earnings potential, and valuation important considerations when identifying attractive investments.

Against this backdrop, we look at the best healthcare stocks to buy for 2027, focusing on companies with strong business fundamentals, promising growth prospects, competitive advantages, and the potential to deliver long-term shareholder value.

Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated (NASDAQ:VRTX) stands out as a healthcare stock to consider for 2027, supported by its dominant position in the cystic fibrosis (CF) treatment market. It also boasts an expanding portfolio of innovative medicines that generates substantial recurring revenue.

Although Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated trades at approximately 25x forward price-to-earnings, compared with the sector average of 19x, strong financial performance and growth outlook support the premium valuation. Third-quarter revenue rose 12% to $3.44 billion, while nine-month revenue increased 11% to $9.76 billion. Consequently, management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.15 billion–$13.25 billion.

Growth continues to be supported by Vertex's leading CF treatments, including Trikafta/Kaftrio, Alyftrek, Kalydeco, and Orkambi. The company is also pursuing growth beyond cystic fibrosis, with a focus on CASGEVY for sickle cell and JOURNAVX for acute pain. Investors are closely watching whether these newer treatments can become meaningful growth drivers. We recently examined this opportunity in  Vertex Pharmaceuticals' New Drugs Are Gaining Ground. Is That Enough for Investors? , which explores the progress of the company's expanding drug portfolio.

Another important catalyst for 2027 is Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated's potential entry into the kidney disease treatment market with povetacicept for IgA nephropathy (IgAN). If approved, povetacicept could establish nephrology as another major commercial franchise for Vertex. The company is also targeting growth in the endocrinology market with a $10 billion acquisition of Crinetics Pharmaceuticals.

Wall Street analysts are also touting the company's prospects heading into 2027. On November 4, Barclays raised its price target to $626 from $617 while reiterating an Overweight rating, impressed by Q3 results. Scotiabank also raised its price target by $102 to $660 while reiterating an Outperform rating, impressed with the sale of Alyftrek and Casgevy beating estimates.

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of VRTX as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. If you're looking for an extremely undervalued AI stock that also stands to benefit significantly from Trump-era tariffs and the onshoring trend, see our free report on the best short-term AI stock .

chineseContent:
我们刚刚发布了 2027 年 10 只最佳医疗保健股票名单，Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated 在此名单中排名第 9 位。

在医疗服务需求不断增长、制药创新和生物技术进步的支持下，医疗保健行业正在成为 2027 年极具吸引力的投资机会。对慢性病、肿瘤、肥胖和其他复杂疾病治疗的投资不断增加也创造了机会。

医疗保健股在 2026 年实现了稳健上涨。标准普尔 500 指数医疗保健板块今年已上涨 15%，几乎是大盘 5.52% 涨幅的三倍，凸显了人们对医疗保健股的重新关注。华尔街还在寻找股价达到创纪录水平的公司的机会，正如我们在《华尔街》评选的 10 支历史最佳买入股票的报告中所强调的那样。

在上涨的同时，华尔街分析师也变得越来越看好，因为该行业在技术之外提供了更具吸引力的机会。不断增长的乐观情绪是由盈利预期的改善、有吸引力的估值以及该行业将受益于人工智能 (AI) 的前景推动的。

据道富投资管理公司称，该行业的盈利将继续改善。其前景将改善生物制药基本面、恢复生命科学服务需求以及稳定管理式医疗业务视为重要的催化剂。

AllianceBernstein 则认为，医疗保健的创新渠道仍然强劲，投资者可能忽视了该行业的增长潜力，因为他们集中在人工智能相关的股票上。在人工智能抛售期间远离科技股也为投资者提供了探索具有有吸引力的增长前景和巨大上涨潜力的医疗保健股票的机会。

分析师还看到了老牌制药公司的机会——投资主题集中在强劲的现金流、成熟的药物组合和股息支付上。民主党在中期选举中大获全胜后，最好的医疗保健和保险股也出现了上涨。这是因为他们预计将推动医疗补助资金和平价医疗法案补贴的潜在变化。

然而，医疗保健股面临着不同的挑战。监管不确定性、药品定价压力、专利到期以及仿制药的竞争带来了重大风险。这些因素使得公司基本面、收入增长、盈利潜力和估值成为确定有吸引力的投资时的重要考虑因素。

在此背景下，我们着眼于 2027 年最值得买入的医疗保健股票，重点关注业务基本面强劲、增长前景光明、具有竞争优势以及有潜力实现长期股东价值的公司。

Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated（纳斯达克股票代码：VRTX）凭借其在囊性纤维化 (CF) 治疗市场的主导地位，成为 2027 年值得考虑的医疗保健股票。它还拥有不断扩大的创新药物组合，可产生大量经常性收入。

尽管 Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated 的预期市盈率约为 25 倍，而行业平均水平为 19 倍，但强劲的财务业绩和增长前景支撑了溢价估值。第三季度收入增长 12% 至 34.4 亿美元，而前九个月收入增长 11% 至 97.6 亿美元。因此，管理层将 2026 年全年收入指导上调至 131.5 亿美元至 132.5 亿美元。

Vertex 领先的 CF 治疗方法继续支持增长，包括 Trikafta/Kaftrio、Alyftrek、Kalydeco 和 Orkambi。该公司还追求囊性纤维化以外的增长，重点是用于镰状细胞病的 CASGEVY 和用于急性疼痛的 JOURNAVX。投资者正在密切关注这些新疗法是否能够成为有意义的增长动力。我们最近在 Vertex Pharmaceuticals 的《新药正在取得进展》中研究了这一机会。这对投资者来说足够了吗？ ，探讨了该公司扩大药物组合的进展。

2027 年的另一个重要催化剂是福泰制药公司 (Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated) 可能凭借治疗 IgA 肾病 (IgAN) 的 povetacicept 进入肾脏疾病治疗市场。如果获得批准，povetacicept 可以将肾病学打造成 Vertex 的另一个主要商业特许经营权。该公司还以 100 亿美元收购 Crinetics Pharmaceuticals 来瞄准内分泌市场的增长。

华尔街分析师也在吹捧该公司进入 2027 年的前景。11 月 4 日，巴克莱银行将其目标股价从 617 美元上调至 626 美元，同时重申增持评级，因第三季度业绩令人印象深刻。丰业银行还将其目标股价上调 102 美元，至 660 美元，同时重申优于大盘评级，对 Alyftrek 和 Casgevy 的出售超出预期印象深刻。

虽然我们承认 VRTX 作为一项投资的风险和潜力，但我们相信某些人工智能股票具有更大的上涨潜力，并且下行风险较小。如果您正在寻找一只被极度低估的人工智能股票，并且该股票也将从特朗普时代的关税和离岸趋势中受益匪浅，请参阅我们关于最佳短期人工智能股票的免费报告。
